name: Lausanne

items.label: Taxable income (Vaud)
items.note: Net salary less the professional costs lump sum and CHF 5,000 for health and accident insurance premiums.

items.label: Cantonal base tax (Vaud)
items.note: Vaud's 2026 tariff: 1% on the first CHF 1,600, rising in steps to 15.5% above CHF 291,700.

items.label: Cantonal tax (Vaud)
items.note: The base tax times the 155% cantonal coefficient, less the 5% reduction for 2026.

items.label: City tax (Lausanne)
items.note: 78.5% of the cantonal base tax, Lausanne's rate for 2026. No church tax in Vaud.
